title: NANSEN project catalog
description: The projects a user has opened, for the app's project list: a file the app is given, not a global setting. The default location is per user (nansen.default_catalog_path / nansen.Catalog.defaultPath), but code that uses a catalog receives one.

path.description: Absolute path of the project folder.

settings.description: The user's app settings. Missing ones take their defaults.

autoStart.description: Start the background worker when the app opens a project, so queued tasks run without pressing Start.

worker.description: How the background worker runs tasks. thread: on a thread of the app's process (in MATLAB, backgroundPool). process: each task in a process of its own (in MATLAB, on a process pool of the Parallel Computing Toolbox, as dev ran tasks), for methods that cannot run on a thread, such as MEX files and most toolboxes.

folder.description: Where add-ons from GitHub are downloaded; empty for ~/.nansen/addons. MATLAB puts the add-ons there on its path when an app or API starts.

python.description: The Python a MATLAB app starts a worker with (queue.startWorker), for tasks only Python runs; empty for MATLAB's pyenv, else python3 (python on Windows).

matlab.description: The MATLAB a Python app starts a worker with, for tasks only MATLAB runs; empty for matlab on the PATH.

saveToDataFolders.description: When a row is edited in the app, write it as <entity type>_info.json into each of its entity's folders, as dev's AutosaveMetadataToDataFolders.
